name: City of Burbank GIS / ArcGIS REST
agency: City of Burbank Information Technology — GIS Team
rateLimit: Unknown; ArcGIS maxRecordCount applies per layer
historicalCoverage: Varies by layer; landbase is current inventory
howToObtain: Query the public REST directory at https://mobilegis.burbankca.gov/burgis/rest/services (map portal https://gis.burbankca.gov/). Some layers may require a token; confirm per service.

name: Burbank business licenses
agency: City of Burbank — Finance / Business License
rateLimit: Not published as a bulk API
historicalCoverage: Unknown until a bulk extract is obtained
howToObtain: No bulk license API. Register or apply at https://www.burbankca.gov/web/community-development/business-license-tax. Request a public extract via CPRA at https://www.burbankca.gov/web/city-clerks-office/public-records-request. CityScope does not display fabricated license counts.

name: Burbank building permits / development
agency: City of Burbank — Community Development / City Clerk
rateLimit: OnBase Public Access custom query; not a documented bulk download
howToObtain: Public OnBase search (no login) at https://ccpa.burbankca.gov/PublicAccess/cq-search/index.html, Search Type Building Documents. City page: https://www.burbankca.gov/web/city-clerks-office/public-records-portal. Refresh with node scripts/fetch-onbase-permits.mjs into OnBase-Building-Permits.csv. This listing has no valuation. Burbank Online Permits remains an applicant portal, not this dataset.

name: Burbank OpenGov financial transparency
rateLimit: Web portal; bulk API access is not documented for this instance
historicalCoverage: FY 2023-24 through 2026-27 Annual — Departments; AP payments 2025-08-01 through 2026-07-31
howToObtain: No public signup; Login is city staff only. Annual — Departments: https://burbankca.opengov.com/transparency then Share → Spreadsheet (.csv) as Burbank Data Snapshot.csv. Accounts Payable: https://burbankca.opengov.com/data/#/1296 (Vendor Payment Listing). Refresh AP with node scripts/fetch-opengov-ap.mjs into OpenGov-Accounts-Payable.csv. These files are not a contracts register.
statusDetail: 16 departments from local Burbank Data Snapshot.csv; 17034 AP payments from local OpenGov-Accounts-Payable.csv

name: Burbank eFile campaign statements
agency: City of Burbank — City Clerk / FPPC
rateLimit: Public web search; export is limited to a one-year filing-date window
historicalCoverage: 2022 and 2024 campaign-year Form 460 for five sitting city council members
howToObtain: Public search at https://efile.burbankca.gov/public/search/campaign. Year-end Form 460 Line 5 Column B is the calendar-year contribution total; do not sum overlapping 460s. Itemized names are Schedule A from every campaign-year 460 for that committee. Independent expenditures are on other committees’ Form 496s. This CityScope extract covers the five sitting council members (2022: Mullins 1450408, Perez 1448423, Takahashi 1448296; 2024: Rizzotti 1466605, Anthony 1470392).

name: Burbank Police Department public crime data
howToObtain: Incident-level BPD records are not a public bulk API. Submit a CPRA request at https://www.burbankca.gov/web/city-clerks-office/public-records-request (search published records at https://www.burbankca.gov/web/city-clerks-office/public-records-portal). Annual agency totals: FBI CDE after https://api.data.gov/signup/ (ORI CA0191200), or CA DOJ OpenJustice at https://openjustice.doj.ca.gov/data. CityScope does not display fabricated incident counts.

name: U.S. Census Bureau ACS / Decennial
rateLimit: Census Data API now requires a key
geographicCoverage: Burbank city, CA; tracts; block groups
howToObtain: Request a free Census API key at https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html. Snapshots below use published QuickFacts / ACS tables.
statusDetail: Published snapshot. Live keyed ingest stays local.

name: California Open Data
geographicCoverage: California; filter to Burbank / LA County
howToObtain: Search and download at https://data.ca.gov/dataset?q=Burbank (portal https://data.ca.gov/). Public datasets do not require a key. Add connectors per dataset.

name: Los Angeles County GIS
howToObtain: Browse https://egis-lacounty.hub.arcgis.com/search or query REST at https://public.gis.lacounty.gov/arcgis/rest/services. Clip features to the Burbank city boundary. Public layers do not require a key.

name: NWS / weather.gov forecast
historicalCoverage: Forecast periods only (not a climate archive)
howToObtain: Browser GET https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=34.1808&lon=-118.3090&FcstType=dwml (DWML XML, no key). If XML is blocked, fall back to https://api.weather.gov/gridpoints/LOX/154,51/forecast and label that JSON fallback. NOAA CDO is a separate keyed archive — do not put that token in the browser.

name: USGS earthquake catalog
historicalCoverage: 2026 YTD in the live browser query (starttime=2026-01-01); catalog itself is longer
howToObtain: Browser GET https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query?format=xml&latitude=34.1808&longitude=-118.3090&maxradiuskm=40&starttime=2026-01-01&minmagnitude=2.5 (QuakeML XML, no key). Filter is 40 km from Burbank center, M≥2.5, 2026-01-01 through request time (2026 YTD). Parse in the client.

name: CA DOJ OpenJustice crimes and clearances
agency: California Department of Justice — Criminal Justice Statistics Center
rateLimit: Statewide annual files; no live incident API
geographicCoverage: California agencies including Burbank PD and Glendale PD
howToObtain: Download Crimes and Clearances from OpenJustice and filter to Burbank PD or Glendale PD. These are annual agency totals, not geocoded incidents. CityScope does not display fabricated incident counts.

name: CA DOJ OpenJustice hate crime
agency: California Department of Justice — Criminal Justice Statistics Center
rateLimit: Statewide event-level file; no live incident API
geographicCoverage: Burbank PD (NCIC 1912 / Los Angeles County 19). The CSV has no city name.
howToObtain: Download Hate Crimes 2001–2025 from https://data-openjustice.doj.ca.gov/data/hate-crime and filter NCIC=1912 (Burbank PD). Do not use statewide totals as Burbank. These are reported events, not geocoded incidents. CityScope does not display fabricated incident counts.

name: FBI Crime Data Explorer (agency summaries)
geographicCoverage: Burbank PD (ORI CA0191200) and Glendale PD (ORI CA0192500)
howToObtain: Request a free api.data.gov key at https://api.data.gov/signup/ then query summarized agency offenses (explorer https://cde.ucr.cjis.gov/). This is annual totals, not a live incident map.
statusDetail: Published snapshot. Live keyed ingest stays local.

name: NOAA Climate Data Online
howToObtain: Request a free CDO token at https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/cdo-web/token. Forecast weather uses NWS (public) until the token is set.
statusDetail: Published snapshot. Live keyed ingest stays local.

name: SWITRS / TIMS traffic collisions
agency: California Highway Patrol / UC Berkeley TIMS
geographicCoverage: California; Burbank extract, plus Glendale when Crashes-Glendale.csv is present
historicalCoverage: Collision records in the local TIMS exports (Burbank 2023; Glendale 2023–2025 when loaded)
howToObtain: Create a free TIMS account at https://tims.berkeley.edu/register.php then export Burbank collisions. Statewide CCRS files: https://data.ca.gov/dataset/ccrs. CityScope does not display fabricated crash points.
statusDetail: 508 Burbank records from local Crashes.csv; 2085 Glendale records from local Crashes-Glendale.csv

name: Hollywood Burbank Airport activity
howToObtain: Download published passenger and cargo PDFs from https://www.hollywoodburbankairport.com/about-us/airport-statistics/. CityScope does not display fabricated passenger counts.

name: AirNow / SCAQMD air quality
howToObtain: Request an AirNow API key. SCAQMD also publishes regional reports.
statusDetail: Published snapshot. Live keyed ingest stays local.

name: Flock / ALPR
howToObtain: Treat as restricted. Public usage stats only: https://transparency.flocksafety.com/burbank-ca-pd (city page https://www.burbankca.gov/web/police-department/flock-safety). Plate reads are not public; request via CPRA at https://www.burbankca.gov/web/city-clerks-office/public-records-request. CityScope will not ingest ALPR reads without authorization.

name: BPD use-of-force and complaints
howToObtain: Request via CPRA at https://www.burbankca.gov/web/city-clerks-office/public-records-request. Published complaint summaries (not incident files) are on https://www.burbankca.gov/web/police-department/transparency. Do not assume records exist in a public bulk feed. Display Access Status: Restricted until produced.

name: BPD policies and training documents
howToObtain: Collect SB 978 policy PDFs from https://www.burbankca.gov/web/police-department/transparency. Confirm before scraping.
